answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on redundant verification across independent nodes. Reaching the cedar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the zephyr of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
